Authoritative final wait4 accounts for worker and reaped descendants, with conservative charging if crash cleanup prevents complete descendant accounting. Serial source and measurement results remain the exact value reference.

Complete published-record parity against frozen check-7 windows AND frozen check-7 measurement arithmetic; public input validation, source identity, poisoning and exact integer path semantics retained. Preparation remains charged to the existing whole-trade CPU region.
purpose: Validate full retained-source fixed causal swings, confirmed one-minute pivots, five closed-window aggression-memory constructions, and a separate reported-BBO reinitialization candidate. Annual/date-block family validation statistics and timing on the complete eligible cohort, with actual source-partition packing and measured total validation cost.

reuse_applicability: Prior results retain their original successful supervisor, worker, source/config/runtime and full reproducible snapshots. Original all-field equality and complete event/native/measurement comparisons support value reuse; the old source cost projection is retained as inapplicable. Attained non-snapshot flag endpoints establish possible earlier ownership, snapshot-only groups cannot change ownership. Unproved cases retain every file ID. Resource metadata only, never a selector.

The declared reported-BBO candidate may restart local BBO trust under its explicit source assumption; it never repairs historical trade/flow completeness, ownership or coordinates and does not replace the original source projection.
source_reference_policy: Compare all nine complete accepted check-9 raw/event/native populations and original whole/atomic/cohort/TPO/coordinate/coverage definitions. Native floating-integral tolerances remain 1e-6 absolute/1e-12 relative. Complete original canonical measurement JSON bytes must equal current restricted-domain bytes. source_schedule: Every original source/day remains scheduled. Bound raw allocations by selected-group IDs plus all possible earlier ordinary owners. The reader batch allowance is ceiling(physical rows/65536) plus the intervening selected row-group boundaries, checked against actual decoder output before publication. Check 4 underestimated reader batches by omitting those boundary splits.
storage_encoding_candidate: Preserve accepted exact native structural differences; remove ask-minus-bid from the encoder after its measured quote-size increase. All existing v1 descriptors remain readable, with all logical values, nulls, sentinels and types preserved.

Raw known-at values remain retained beside the view. It is not an assertion of observed receipt or zero actual latency.

This is a bounded source-cost arithmetic probe, not selected thresholds, rolling lifetime/visits, annual inference or a venue certificate.
structure_memory_validation.source_variants: All original acquired source variants and every listed raw instrument remain separate; no economic deduplication, no selected-only full-source substitute.
